notes: Generated by go test ./internal/estateprofile/ -update-vectors. Every value below is re-derived and compared on every run.

Key material is derived from fixed labels: seed = sha256("melusina-estate-profile-vector-key:" + label), key = Ed25519 from that seed. No private key is stored here and none of it has authority anywhere.
A placeholder address is base58(sha256("MELUSINA_ILLUSTRATIVE_PLACEHOLDER_V1:" + label)); a placeholder digest is that sha256 in hex. It is canonically valid and deliberately fictitious.

preimageHex is the canonical digest preimage: W(domain) then every field in declaration order, top-level signatures excluded. profileSha256 is its SHA-256. A second implementation must reproduce both byte for byte.
goSources is the SHA-256 of every non-test Go file of the package the vectors gate. The deployer, the Store and authz carry byte-identical copies; a copy that drifts fails its own suite.

The paype-devnet vector is ILLUSTRATIVE. Its public values are read from tracked sources and read-only devnet readback; every field named in illustrativeFields is a placeholder and is not a measurement of the live estate.

profiles.name: new-estate-revision-1
profiles.description: A fictitious new estate at revision 1: owner policy 2 of 3, no succession, no recalls, prev unstated.

profiles.name: new-estate-revision-2-migrate
profiles.description: Revision 2 of the same estate: authority handed to a 3-of-4 successor policy by a step signed by 2 of the genesis policy. Same estateId and genesis, prev informational.

profiles.name: new-estate-revision-2-recalling-revision-1
profiles.description: The same migration, additionally recalling revision 1's digest. A consumer still pinned at revision 1 halts mutation by name against this profile and migrates out of it with no wipe.

profiles.name: paype-devnet-revision-1
profiles.description: The retiring estate from public values: devnet genesis, the Squads v4 program, the licence registry and witness verifier program ids, the witness verifier final (no upgrade authority), the core multisig and its vault, the licence registry's observed upgrade authority, the root install admin, and the root store bazaar.melusina-os.org. Role shape and other fields remain illustrative where listed.

decodeVectors.name: duplicate-key
decodeVectors.description: The same key twice at the top level. A decoder that keeps the last one decodes a document nobody signed.

decodeVectors.name: unknown-field
decodeVectors.description: A field this schema does not define. Decision 4 says there is no stage field, and an unknown key stops rather than being ignored.

decodeVectors.name: mainnet-genesis
decodeVectors.description: The one protocol constant: no profile naming the mainnet-beta genesis is ever accepted, whatever its label says.

decodeVectors.name: non-integer-revision
decodeVectors.description: A number that is not a plain non-negative safe integer, so the JavaScript twin cannot decode it to a different value.

decodeVectors.name: missing-field
decodeVectors.description: Every key of every object is required: nothing is optional and nothing defaults.

decodeVectors.name: final-program-with-authority
decodeVectors.description: The witness verifier is deployed final: finalized read-back finds no upgrade authority. A profile naming one asks its owners to sign an authority the chain does not have.

decodeVectors.name: final-program-stated-governed
decodeVectors.description: The witness verifier stated as a governed program with the core vault as its authority, as revisions of these vectors before the final state existed did.

decodeVectors.name: governed-program-stated-final
decodeVectors.description: The licence registry stays governed by the core vault. Final is a closed property of the witness-verifier role, not a choice a profile makes.

decodeVectors.name: governed-program-without-authority
decodeVectors.description: A governed program with no stated authority is a half-profile, refused as incomplete rather than read as final.

decodeVectors.name: program-final-missing
decodeVectors.description: The final flag is required on every program; its absence is not a default of false.

decodeVectors.name: program-final-not-boolean
decodeVectors.description: The final flag is a JSON boolean; the string "true" is a different document.

decodeVectors.name: draft-not-enrollable
decodeVectors.description: The unsigned chain-foundation input is refused as a draft, not as a list of unknown fields.

decodeVectors.name: trailing-data
decodeVectors.description: One document per input. A second value after the first is refused rather than ignored.

decodeVectors.name: changed-threshold-without-succession
decodeVectors.description: The current policy's threshold was raised with no succession step, so the verified chain does not arrive at the policy that signed.

decodeVectors.name: self-signed-successor
decodeVectors.description: The succession step is signed by the keys it introduces instead of by a threshold of the policy it leaves.

decodeVectors.name: estate-id-not-self-certifying
decodeVectors.description: The nonce was changed, so the estateId is no longer the one the genesis policy and nonce certify.

decodeVectors.name: owner-signatures-insufficient
decodeVectors.description: One valid signature under a threshold of two.

acceptVectors.name: select-on-empty-consumer
acceptVectors.description: UNENROLLED to ENROLLED(1) on a provably empty consumer.

acceptVectors.name: select-on-live
acceptVectors.description: A restored or non-empty consumer directory is never treated as empty.

acceptVectors.name: select-on-unknown-consumer
acceptVectors.description: Absent, failed and unknown are different: unknown stops.

acceptVectors.name: migrate
acceptVectors.description: ENROLLED(1) to ENROLLED(2): same estateId and genesis, higher revision, chain through the pinned policy.

acceptVectors.name: migrate-out-of-a-recall
acceptVectors.description: HALTED to ENROLLED. The profile that recalls the pin is exactly the one that recovers the consumer.

acceptVectors.name: older-revision
acceptVectors.description: Acceptance is forward monotonic: at or below the pinned revision is not a migration.

acceptVectors.name: same-revision
acceptVectors.description: A retry after a successful persist is not a change.

acceptVectors.name: foreign-estate
acceptVectors.description: Another estate's profile, correctly signed by its own owners, is not a migration of this one.

acceptVectors.name: foreign-pin
acceptVectors.description: The mirror image: this estate's profile is not a migration for a consumer pinned to another one.

guardVectors.name: recalled
guardVectors.description: A newer profile recalls the pinned digest, so every mutation halts by name.

guardVectors.name: recalled-observation-still-works
guardVectors.description: The same recall leaves observation working, so an operator can read the estate that told them to stop.

guardVectors.name: not-recalled
guardVectors.description: A newer profile that recalls nothing does not halt anything.

guardVectors.name: witness-from-another-estate
guardVectors.description: A recall is only this estate's when the profile carrying it is this estate's.

projectionVectors.name: foreign-anchor
projectionVectors.description: A spec or challenge that carries another estate's master mint.

projectionVectors.name: foreign-anchor-program
projectionVectors.description: The same control on the licence registry program id.

projectionVectors.name: final-program-authority-undefined
projectionVectors.description: A final program has no upgrade authority, so the estate defines no such value: a declaration of one is unknown, not compared with an empty string.

projectionVectors.name: governed-program-authority-matches
projectionVectors.description: The positive control: the governed licence registry's authority is still an estate value a declaration must equal.

projectionVectors.name: projection-field-unknown
projectionVectors.description: A declared key this estate does not define. Unknown stops; it is not an absent value with a default.

projectionVectors.name: projection-matches
projectionVectors.description: The positive control: the recorded retiring-estate values match their projection.

projectionVectors.name: relabelled-network
projectionVectors.description: The label is display only. A profile read against a network whose genesis is not its own is refused whatever it calls itself.

projectionVectors.name: genesis-matches
projectionVectors.description: The devnet profile against the real devnet genesis hash.

projectionVectors.name: mainnet-genesis-observed
projectionVectors.description: The protocol constant refuses mainnet on the observed side too, before any estate comparison.
